title: Identity-Locked Fashion Sequence
description: A nine-image identity-locked portrait sequence for Fitness Wellness Brand Portraits: one reference frame followed by eight controlled variations that preserve the same subject while changing lighting, styling, scene, or emotional register.
creative_direction: Use image 01 as the fixed identity anchor for Fitness Wellness Brand Portraits. Images 02-09 must all depend on that reference and preserve the same face, hair base, skin-tone family, and body proportions while translating the backlog brief into a coherent portrait system.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-fashion-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-campaign-hero-look, 03-tailored-three-quarter, 04-full-body-runway, 05-seated-lookbook-crop, 06-movement-editorial, 07-closeup-fabric-beauty, 08-lighting-shift-portrait, 09-finale-cover-portrait. Queue may run 02-09 concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
